title: Commercial Property Paralegal
description:
Commercial Property Paralegal Warwickshire Salary DOE

A quality role, a supportive team and the opportunity to take real ownership of your work.

I'm working with a leading law firm looking to bring an experienced Commercial Property Paralegal into its team in Warwickshire.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys commercial property work and wants to be part of a firm that gets the balance right: high-quality work, genuine autonomy and a working environment where people feel supported and valued.

You'll have the opportunity to play an important role in the team, take ownership of your workload and work on a varied range of commercial property matters, with the support of experienced colleagues around you.

Importantly, this is a role where the emphasis is on doing good work in the right environment. If you're looking to move away from an overly pressured or volume-driven set-up and into a team that values quality, collaboration and a manageable workload, this could be well worth exploring.

What makes this opportunity stand out?
- Quality of work: Exposure to a varied caseload of commercial property matters, giving you the opportunity to build on your existing experience.
- Autonomy and ownership: The chance to take responsibility for your work, play an active role in transactions and make a genuine contribution to the team.
- A supportive culture: Work alongside approachable, experienced colleagues who value teamwork and provide support when you need it.
- A manageable workload: A more balanced approach, allowing you to focus on delivering quality work without the expectation of simply processing volume.
- Long-term development: An opportunity to continue building your commercial property expertise within a leading firm that offers a positive environment to grow.

Who would suit this role?

I'm keen to speak with experienced Commercial Property Paralegals who have a solid grounding in commercial property transactions, take pride in their work and are looking for a role where they can develop their expertise while enjoying the environment they work in.

You might already be happy in your current position but feel ready for a change of environment, or perhaps you're looking for greater responsibility and a team that offers the right level of support.

Either way, if quality of work, culture and work-life balance are important to you, this is an opportunity worth a conversation.

Location: Warwickshire

Salary: Dependent on experience

If you'd like to hear more, get in touch for a confidential discussion. I'd be happy to talk you through the opportunity and give you a better feel for the team and what the role could offer.

At Gleeson Recruitment Group, we embrace inclusivity and welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We are proud to be a disability confident employer.

By applying you will be registered as a candidate with Gleeson Recruitment Limited. Our Privacy Policy is available on our website and explains how we will use your data.

title: Conveyancing Paralegal
company: Talentwise Solutions Legal Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Residential Conveyancing Paralegal

Location: Coventry, with free onsite parking

Salary: £27,500 to £32,000 commensurate with experience and qualifications

Bonus Scheme: The firm operate a performance-related bonus scheme, with top billers earning up to £3k per month.

About the firm

This is a well-established, independent law firm based in Coventry, with an excellent reputation, consistently good client reviews, a loyal client following and close ties to the local community.

The firm provide a supportive, close-knit working environment where employees have exposure to a broad range of conveyancing work ensuring genuine career progression at your own pace. With a performance-related bonus scheme in place, there is a great scope to earn a high income, significantly increasing your annual salary in recognition of your hard work.

About the Conveyancing Team

There are around 15 people in the conveyancing team, handling a high volume and wide variety of residential property matters. The firm maintain a supportive working environment where members of the team are encouraged to ask questions, learn from more experienced colleagues and develop their own careers, rather than being restricted to one part of the conveyancing process.

What you'll be doing:

Your level of responsibility will be commensurate with your knowledge and experience and will include all or some of the following duties:
- Working closely with experienced members of the conveyancing department, gaining practical exposure to a broad range of residential conveyancing work
- Developing your own conveyancing ability, managing and progressing files under supervision
- Working at your own pace to become increasingly independent
- Liaising directly with clients, estate agents, solicitors, lenders and other parties
- Reviewing title documentation and property searches
- Raising and responding to conveyancing enquiries
- Preparing matters for exchange and completion
- Dealing with freehold and leasehold transactions
- Assisting with transfers of equity, remortgages and other residential property matters
- Preparing correspondence, reports and relevant conveyancing documentation
- Ensuring clients are kept regularly updated throughout their transactions.
- Taking on increasing responsibility as your knowledge and confidence grows, whilst always having appropriate supervision available

Who we're looking for:

Suitable candidates will have:
- A good grounding in residential conveyancing (12 months'+ experience)
- A strong work ethic
- A willingness to learn and develop
- The ability to work well as part of a team
- Excellent communication skills
- A desire to progress your career within residential conveyancing

What's on offer:

The role offers a fabulous opportunity to gain hands on experience, develop your own caseload under supervision with a view to progressing into a more senior fee earning role within the firm over time.

Benefits Include:
- 20 days annual leave plus 8 bank holidays
- Additional paid leave over the Christmas shut down period (between Christmas and New Year) which does not have to be retained from your own entitlement
- Additional paid leave twice per year for Eid Celebrations which does not have to be retained from your own entitlement
- Performance related bonus scheme
- Free on-site parking, subject to availability
- Ongoing training and professional development
- Support for longer-term career progression and professional qualifications (SQE, CILEx and CLC routes are supported)
- A supportive and collaborative working environment

This is a full-time permanent job, working 9:00am to 5:30pm Monday to Friday (37.5 hours per week) The role is fully office-based.

Note: Salary stated is given as a guideline in line with market rate and will be wholly commensurate with experience. The information provided above is correct to the best of our knowledge.

For more information, please contact Tracey at Talentwise Solutions Legal Recruitment

About Talentwise Solutions Legal Recruitment

Talentwise Solutions Legal Recruitment is a family-run, boutique recruitment agency specialising in legal professional and legal support jobs throughout Coventry and Warwickshire, Birmingham and the Midlands.

We offer a tailored service, to find the right role and the right cultural fit for our candidates, and rest assured we will never forward your CV to any firm without first gaining your consent.

About Your Consultant

Tracey is the Owner and Managing Director of Talentwise Solutions Legal Recruitment, where her focus is on offering a prestigious, consultative, open, and honest service - the way she believes recruitment should be!

Tracey's passion for recruitment in the legal sector goes back over thirty years, and today it's stronger than ever. Tracey prides herself on her personalised approach to recruiting and will be on hand to guide you through every stage of the process from initial application through to job offer. You know your career is in great hands with Tracey's experience and expertise.

Know anyone who might be interested? We offer generous bonuses up to £500 for successful referrals. Conditions apply - contact us or view our website for details.

title: Paralegal
description:
Job Title: Paralegal - Graduate Opportunity

Location: City / Office Location

Type: Full-time

About Us:

We are a dynamic and growing legal team providing high-quality services across practice areas, e.g., family, litigation, corporate . We are committed to supporting talent and developing the next generation of legal professionals.

The Role:

We are looking for a motivated Paralegal to join our team. This is an excellent opportunity for law graduates who are eager to gain practical experience, work closely with experienced solicitors, and develop their legal career in a supportive environment.

Key Responsibilities:
- Assist with case preparation, research, and document drafting.
- Draft legal documents, applications, witness statements, and correspondence.
- Manage client communications under supervision and provide support during hearings.
- Maintain accurate case records and filings using legal systems (e.g., HMCTS, CJSM).
- Support day-to-day operations of the legal team, including billing and administrative tasks.
- Ensure compliance with SRA regulations and GDPR standards.

What We're Looking For:
- Law degree (LLB) graduate or equivalent.
- Strong interest in developing a legal career, with attention to detail and professional ethics.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Proactive, organised, and able to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
- Previous legal work experience, volunteering, or internships are desirable but not essential.

What We Offer:
- Hands-on exposure to real cases and client matters.
- Mentorship from experienced solicitors and structured training.
- Opportunity to develop skills relevant to SQE preparation or future qualification.
- A collaborative and supportive work environment.
- Career progression opportunities for high performers.

title: Private Client Paralegal
description:
Private Client Paralegal - Kenilworth

About the Role

Our client is excited to offer an excellent opportunity for a Private Client Executive to join its growing and busy Private Client department. This role is ideal for a motivated and experienced individual looking to play a key part in delivering high-quality legal services within a friendly and supportive team environment.

You will be primarily responsible for will drafting, Lasting Powers of Attorney (LPAs) and supporting the wider probate team, while providing a compassionate and professional service to our clients.

What's On Offer?
- 23 days holiday + your birthday off
- Additional holiday entitlement with length of service
- Christmas closure
- Pension scheme
- Free/subsidised legal fees
- Ongoing training and professional development support
- Company sick pay
- Cycle to Work scheme
- Eyecare vouchers
- Flu jab voucher

Key Responsibilities
- Drafting Wills and preparing Lasting Powers of Attorney (LPAs)
- Advising clients on Wills, LPAs and general tax matters
- Supporting the probate team with non-contentious matters
- Managing client enquiries both in person and over the phone
- Opening and setting up new client files/accounts
- Handling and processing securities and deeds
- Maintaining excellent client care throughout all interactions

About You

To succeed in this role, you will have:
- Proven experience in Private Client work, particularly non-contentious matters
- Strong knowledge of Wills, Probate and LPAs
- Excellent communication skills with a professional and empathetic approach
- The ability to manage clients efficiently and sensitively
- A proactive attitude and strong organisational skills
- A genuine interest in developing your career within Private Client law

Apply

If you're an experienced Private Client Executive seeking to take the next step in your career within a forward-thinking and dynamic law firm, this is an excellent opportunity for you.

title: Property Litigation Paralegal
description:

Client Details

This professional services firm is based in Warwickshire and operates in the legal sector.

Description
- Draft and review legal documents related to property disputes.
- Assist solicitors with case preparation and legal research.
- Communicate with clients, keeping them updated on case progress.
- Manage case files and ensure all documentation is accurately maintained.
- Liaise with external parties such as surveyors and opposing legal teams.
- Monitor and adhere to deadlines for court filings and submissions.
- Provide administrative support to the wider legal team as needed

Profile

A successful Property Litigation Paralegal should have:
- Previous litigation experience is advantageous.
- Strong organisational and communication skills.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Proactive and professional approach to work.
- Genuine interest in property litigation and contentious matters.
- Strong academic background considered where litigation experience is limited

Job Offer
- Permanent position within the legal sector.
- Additional benefits to be confirmed.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.
